desc: Derive the exact game-theoretic characterization, including positions with odd-sized connected components.
Prove the fixed-parity cases where the total number of available moves is invariant.
Establish the winner criterion for flexible-parity cases, including terminal connected components and small exceptions.
Design an \(O(N+M)\) component representation using DSU with parity.
Exhaustively validate the criterion on small legal states.
Implement the corrected algorithm in Python and verify it against all public samples.
